_comment: Facts that differ from the 2.6.13 baseline and were reviewed against the app, per release line
(contract-tests/watch/report.py --reviewed). Key -> the expected new value as the report shows it
(normalized JSON text), null for a fact that is gone, "*" for a value that changes with every build.
A line belongs here only together with its versions in TandoorVersionTable.TESTED (docs/BYGGE.md
"Tandoor-bevakning"). A difference that is not listed, or has another value, still needs attention.

notes: api-token-auth is gone (302 to /account/login/): the app logs in through allauth headless (login.allauth.*, logout.*), 3 logins per minute, 429 without Retry-After.
No login token any more: the token list has only the device token; the revokeLoginToken.* and login-form/multipart facts are gone.
403 detail texts changed; the app never matches on them.
An account without a space is refused (403 + JSON) on every /api/ path, also the token create and list: password login reports 'no space', a pasted token 'invalid token'.
An unknown /api/ path answers 200 with the web app's HTML (the HTML guard; capability probes stop).
server-settings has three new boolean fields the app ignores.
CookLog.servings is a DecimalField (3.0): CookLogDto.servings is a Double, rounded when stored.
